scope: Semantics-correct ten-second H3 bottle handover and rebuilt same-scene three-task AC-WM comparison
summary: The delivered H3 handover now completes the visual right-to-left holder transition: the screen-left gripper closes on the blue bottle, the screen-right gripper opens and withdraws, and the bottle remains screen-left for the final two seconds. The rebuilt handover, unscrew, and rinse comparison passes all fixed semantic, visual, geometry, lineage, and distinctness gates.
evidence: The final handover decodes to 832x480, 240 frames, 24 FPS, and 10.000 seconds with SHA-256 a9d9618c1e1a04a4d9df6ea654e324d59f09e0a23d12062e1bc4d64e18c63f62.

Blue-bottle tracking is valid for 100% of frames; first-window median x is 0.486689, final-two-second median x is 0.413469, final p90 x is 0.471339, and leftward shift is 0.073220. All four automatic transfer checks pass.

Dense contact/release review passes: screen-left fingers close and retain the bottle before screen-right fingers open and the empty gripper separates; dense human-residual, blur, and task reviews also pass.
A conservative ffmpeg unsharp luma amount 0.20 raises handover foreground p10 quality ratio from 0.6908 to 0.7628, clearing the unchanged 0.75 gate; stronger 0.35 and 0.50 variants were not selected.
The final handover/unscrew/rinse foreground p10 ratios are 0.7628/2.1165/1.3818 and safe-background/source ratios are 1.1158/1.1231/1.0457.
Pairwise mean full-frame MAD is 36.6373-44.2518 and every pair is above 2 MAD in every frame; final evaluation status is WORKING and accepted is true.

The source-plus-results comparison SHA-256 is 2758ebef2c12d032d595ff35696c1f669ee28bee66ebb12a4dff3e01f1e53566 and generated-only comparison SHA-256 is 6fbf1a1adca17c26988e2d8444ded47c4578c7e7b4355c10e5b79c4a01c588f1.
lessons: Treat handover as an ordered holder-state transition, not generic two-hand proximity.
Select the minimum detail-recovery strength that clears the predeclared quality gate to avoid unnecessary edge enhancement.
Preserve screen-left/screen-right as named camera-frame directions instead of silently treating them as robot-base coordinates.
limitations: This validates camera-frame visual instruction control in a recorded EPIC-KITCHENS scene, not force-verified contact, collision correctness, calibrated robot state, or physical execution.
A small hard seam remains near frame 123 and is retained instead of using a blur-producing cross-dissolve.
next_actions: Publish the rebuilt artifacts, evaluation, metadata, and corrected AC-WM demo-page text to GitHub Pages and verify the public hashes and media geometry.
